summary: The open AI model ecosystem spans model repositories (like Hugging Face), local-first runtimes (like Ollama), and developer-facing inference APIs (like Replicate, Together AI, Fireworks AI, and SiliconFlow) that serve open-weight models at scale. As of 2026 the Hugging Face Hub has surpassed 3 million public models, with download activity highly concentrated — roughly half of all models have under 200 downloads while the top 200 models account for nearly half of all downloads — and Chinese labs (Moonshot, MiniMax, Z.ai, Qwen, DeepSeek) now rival or exceed U.S. labs in download volume and model scale. These platforms differ primarily by whether they host weights, run models locally, or provide hosted serverless inference with usage-based pricing.

platforms.name: Hugging Face
platforms.purpose: The central hub and community platform for hosting, sharing, versioning, and discovering open models, datasets, and demo Spaces, plus hosted inference endpoints.
platforms.pricing: Free hosting and public repos; PRO subscription (~$9/mo); dedicated Inference Endpoints billed per compute hour; usage-based serverless Inference Providers; Enterprise Hub per-seat plans
features: Largest open model and dataset repository with Git-based versioning
Spaces for hosting live demos and apps
Inference Endpoints and routed Inference Providers for serverless API access
Model cards, download/usage stats, and leaderboards
platforms.best_for: Researchers, ML engineers, and developers who need to find, publish, fine-tune, or evaluate open models and datasets.

platforms.name: Ollama
platforms.purpose: A local-first runtime that makes it simple to download and run open LLMs and multimodal models on your own machine via a single command or local API.
platforms.model_count: ~200+ curated models in its library (quantized variants of Llama, Qwen, Gemma, DeepSeek, Mistral, etc.)
platforms.pricing: Free and open source; optional cloud/hosted offering with usage-based pricing for larger models
features: One-command model pull and run with automatic quantization
Modelfile system for custom model configs and system prompts
platforms.best_for: Developers and hobbyists who want to run open models locally for privacy, prototyping, or offline use.

platforms.name: Replicate
platforms.purpose: A cloud platform for running and deploying open and community models (image, video, audio, and language) via a simple API, with easy packaging of custom models.
platforms.model_count: Thousands of community-published models across modalities
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-use, billed by compute time (per second of GPU/CPU usage) with per-model rates
features: Run models via API with no infrastructure management
Cog framework for packaging and deploying custom models
Strong catalog of image/video/audio generation models
platforms.best_for: App developers and startups who want quick API access to generative models, especially multimodal ones, without managing GPUs.

platforms.name: Together AI
platforms.purpose: A developer inference cloud offering fast, serverless and dedicated access to a broad catalog of open-weight LLMs, plus fine-tuning and GPU clusters.
platforms.model_count: 200+ open models (Llama, Qwen, DeepSeek, Mixtral, and more)
platforms.pricing: Usage-based per-million-tokens serverless pricing; dedicated endpoints and GPU cluster rental billed hourly; fine-tuning priced per token
features: Dedicated endpoints and reserved GPU clusters
Support for the latest large open models including Chinese frontier models
platforms.best_for: Developers and companies building production apps on open LLMs who want scalable, cost-efficient hosted inference and fine-tuning.

platforms.name: Fireworks AI
platforms.purpose: A high-performance inference platform focused on low-latency, cost-efficient serving of open LLMs and multimodal models for production workloads.
platforms.model_count: 100+ open models plus custom model deployment
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token serverless pricing; on-demand dedicated GPU deployments billed hourly; fine-tuning and custom model hosting fees
features: Function calling, JSON mode, and structured output
Fine-tuning (including LoRA) and custom model serving
platforms.best_for: Production teams needing fast, reliable, and low-latency serving of open models with strong tooling for function calling and structured outputs.

platforms.name: SiliconFlow
platforms.purpose: An inference platform (strong in the Chinese and Asian market) providing affordable serverless API access to a wide range of open LLMs and generative models.
platforms.model_count: 100+ open models including Chinese frontier models (Qwen, DeepSeek, GLM/Z.ai, MiniMax, Moonshot)
platforms.pricing: Usage-based per-token pricing, often highly competitive; free tier/credits for some models
features: Strong catalog of Chinese open-weight models
Text, image, and audio generation support
platforms.best_for: Developers (especially in Asia) seeking low-cost serverless access to leading Chinese and global open models.

platforms.name: OpenRouter
platforms.purpose: A unified API gateway that routes requests across many open and proprietary model providers, letting developers access hundreds of models through one endpoint.
platforms.model_count: 300+ models aggregated from dozens of providers
platforms.pricing: Pass-through usage-based per-token pricing with a small markup; pay-as-you-go credits
features: Single OpenAI-compatible API for many providers
Price and latency comparison across providers
Access to both open and closed frontier models
platforms.best_for: Developers who want flexible, provider-agnostic access to many models without managing multiple accounts or APIs.

platforms.name: Groq
platforms.purpose: An inference platform built on custom LPU hardware delivering extremely high token-generation speeds for open LLMs.
platforms.model_count: Dozens of supported open models (Llama, Qwen, Gemma, DeepSeek distills, etc.)
platforms.pricing: Usage-based per-million-tokens pricing; free developer tier available
features: Ultra-low-latency inference via custom LPU hardware
Curated selection of popular open models
platforms.best_for: Developers building real-time or latency-sensitive applications that need the fastest possible open-model inference.
